Name: Easy Petting
Author: CeruleanSpirit
Description:
[list]
[*][b]Version 1.0.0[/b]
[/list]        - Displays a heart bubble over your farm animals until you have petted them.
        - Also works with your pet.
        - Action key is '[b]P[/b]' :
            - You can enable or disable the monitoring by pressing the action key.
            - The action key can be changed in the config.json file.

[list]
[*][b]Version 2.0.0[/b]
[/list]        - This version does the same thing as version 1.0.0
        - It has been released for the sole purpose of being compatible with Stardew Valey 1.3.31 and SMAPI 2.8-beta.6
        - [b]Minimum requirements : with Stardew Valey 1.3.31 and SMAPI 2.8-beta.6
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Version 2.1.0[/b]
[/list]        - This version does the same thing as version 2.0.0
        - It has been released for the sole purpose of being compatible with Stardew Valey 1.3.36 and SMAPI 2.11.2
        - [b]Minimum requirements : with Stardew Valey 1.3.36 and SMAPI 2.11.2[/b]
